Only /admin serves dashboard; /admin/dashboard logs react-router warning (carry-over, non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1014 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, campaigns, wallet, admin, banners, affiliate) before further feature additions.
@app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in modern FastAPI; migrate to lifespan.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login — playbook non-conformance; consider adding a per-email + per-IP counter with 5-fail lockout.

/api/upload authorization is now content-type gated (customers can only upload images); a stronger check on the raw file magic bytes (not just Content-Type header, which is client-supplied) would prevent malicious uploads. Currently a client could send arbitrary bytes with 'Content-Type: image/png' and the server would store it as an image.
